pricing.title: What should a session cost?
pricing.intro: Three steps: your gear, your monthly costs, your salary. Type in your numbers and the price builds as you go. Nothing is saved or sent; it all stays on your device.

session.title: What should a session cost?
session.hint: Work cost + your salary + a profit for the business, divided by your sessions
